title: Restrict a prescribed residue model inside an open below the Tor bound
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ an object of $D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $a,b\in\mathbf Z$. Assume $H^j(E\otimes^L F)=0$ for every module sheaf $F$ and $j<a$ or $j>b$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. Let $U\subseteq S$ be open with inclusion $u$ [def-weil-open-immersion], $x\in U$, and $O\subseteq S$ an affine open containing $u(x)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose a bounded complex $P$ of module sheaves on $O$ is supplied, together with an isomorphism $E|_O\cong P$ in the derived category [def-pc-derived-pullback], and an isomorphism $P^j\cong\mathcal O_O^{\oplus\beta_j(u(x))}$ for every integer $j$ [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. Then there exists an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq U$ of $x$, with inclusion $v$, whose open subscheme is affine, and a bounded-above complex $K$ of module sheaves on $V$, such that $K^j=0$ for $j<a$, $K^j\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus\beta_j(u(x))}$ for every integer $j$, and $L(u\circ v)^*E\cong K$ in the derived category. No closed subscheme or rank locus is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the stalkwise Tor-amplitude criterion at u(x) and tensor with its residue field. The derived residue fibre has zero cohomology below a, hence beta_j(u(x))=0 for j<a. The supplied free-term isomorphisms show that P has zero terms in those degrees. This uses the Tor hypothesis only; the residue model is supplied as input.

Choose an affine open W containing u(x) inside O intersect U, and regard W as an open V of U. Restrict P from O to W and transport module sheaves from the over-site to W.toScheme by the canonical module equivalence. Both functors are exact, preserve zero objects and finite free sheaves with their indexing types, and preserve the upper degree bound. Exact restriction applied to the supplied derived isomorphism, and its comparison with derived pullback, produce L(u composed with v)^*E isomorphic to Q(K). The ranks remain the ranks at the original point u(x).

proof_origin.note: Isolates one strictly structural part of the local chart argument. Edge cases: empty schemes, rank zero and reversed Tor bounds are included.

    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ O : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F j)
    (U : S.Opens) (x : U.toScheme) (O : S.Opens)
    (hxO : U.ι x ∈ O) (hO : IsAffineOpen O)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < c ∨ d < j → IsZero (P.X j))
    (hrank : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (P.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over O)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti S E j (U.ι x))))))
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :
    ∃ V : U.toScheme.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∃ K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, c < j → IsZero (K.X j)) ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, j < a → IsZero (K.X j)) ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti S E j (U.ι x)))))) ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback (V.ι ≫ U.ι)).obj E ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
